# `aitbc messaging send`

Post a forum message as a signed MESSAGE transaction. The default is a DRY RUN: it prints the wallet, sender address, topic, body length and fee and signs nothing. ``--confirm`` resolves the wallet password, signs once and submits once.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging send [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name that signs the post (the message author) |
| `--message` | text | — | yes | Message body (public and permanent) |
| `--topic` | text | `broadcast` | no | Topic slug (lowercased, whitespace → '-') |
| `--reply-to` | text | — | no | Parent message tx_hash — makes the post a reply (bare or 0x-prefixed 64-hex) |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee (AIT) |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Sign and submit once (default: dry run — prints the post, signs nothing) |
| `--wait`, `--no-wait` | flag | `true` | no | With --confirm: poll /rpc/messaging/messages/<hash> until the post is indexed (default: --wait); --no-wait prints only the submitted hash |
| `--wait-timeout` | float | `180.0` | no | Seconds --wait polls for |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging send --wallet <wallet_name> --message <message>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging send --wallet <wallet_name> --message <message> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
